verdict.rationale: Amplitude's docs explicitly claim self-serve funnel building, segmentation, and 'answer why' analytics with charts/dashboards, plus AI-driven plain-language Q&A that could help a founder self-serve without an analyst, and session replay to see where users drop off. However, community evidence flags real implementation difficulty and data-quality complaints, suggesting the self-serve promise doesn't always hold without expertise. Missing for 10: independent case study of a non-analyst founder successfully diagnosing drop-off unaided, and no direct rebuttal to the hands-on complaint about integration difficulty/data accuracy.
